pages.title: Track Your Progress
pages.text: Carry a discovery and open this encyclopedia to record it. The item is not consumed; each reward can be claimed once.

pages.title: Crystals
pages.text: Goal: have one White Aura Crystal. Reward: 64 White Aura Crystals. Read $(l:aura:white_aura_crystal)White Aura Crystal$(/l) and $(l:aura:arcane_progression)Arcane Progression$(/l).

pages.title: Nodes
pages.text: Goal: have one Aura Node. Reward: 16 Aura Nodes. See $(l:aura:node_variants)Node Variants$(/l) for the node family and its recipes.

pages.title: Pumps
pages.text: Goal: have one Aura Node Pump. Reward: 64 Sticks. See $(l:aura:pump_variants)Pump Variants$(/l) to choose a pump and read its offering.

pages.title: Furnace
pages.text: Goal: have one Cascading Smelter. Reward: 64 White Aura Crystals. See $(l:aura:consumer_fieldwork)Consumer Workflows$(/l) for item placement and $(l:aura:consumers_vortex)shared power costs$(/l).

pages.title: Red Crystals
pages.text: Goal: have one Red Aura Crystal. Reward: 4 TNT. See $(l:aura:aura_colors)Aura Colors$(/l) for Red Aura's lift behavior.

pages.title: Processor
pages.text: Goal: have one Cascading Processor. Reward: 8 Coal. See $(l:aura:arcane_progression)Arcane Progression$(/l) for processor recipes and placement.

pages.title: Dye
pages.text: Goal: have one Cascading Colorer. Reward: 32 White Wool. See $(l:aura:consumer_fieldwork)Consumer Workflows$(/l) for sheep care and $(l:aura:consumers_vortex)shared power costs$(/l).

pages.title: Arcane Ingot
pages.text: Goal: have one White Arcane Ingot. Reward: 15 White Arcane Ingots. See $(l:aura:arcane_progression)Arcane Progression$(/l) for all eight colors.

pages.title: Vortex Infusion
pages.text: Goal: have one Vortex Controller. Reward: 4 Vortex Pedestals. See $(l:aura:consumers_vortex)Consumers and Vortex$(/l) for the cardinal layout and falling-power receipts.

pages.title: Arcane Gem
pages.text: Goal: have one White Arcane Gem. Reward: 8 White Arcane Gems. See $(l:aura:arcane_progression)Arcane Progression$(/l) for the matching-color route.

pages.title: Arcane Prism
pages.text: Goal: have an Arcane Prism. Reward: one Arcane Prism. See $(l:aura:arcane_progression)Arcane Progression$(/l) for the eight-distinct-gem Processor recipe.

pages.title: Synthesizer
pages.text: Goal: have one Cascading Synthesizer. Reward: 64 White Aura Crystals. See $(l:aura:arcane_progression)Arcane Progression$(/l) for its no-input Angelsteel output.

pages.title: Angelsteel
pages.text: Goal: have a tier-two Angelsteel Ingot. Reward: 15 tier-one Angelsteel Ingots. See $(l:aura:arcane_progression)Arcane Progression$(/l), $(l:aura:angelsteel_tools)Tools$(/l), and $(l:aura:angelsteel_swords)Swords$(/l).

pages.title: Fairies
pages.text: Goal: have a Ring of Binding. Reward: one Fairy Charm. See $(l:aura:accessory_loadout)Accessory Loadout$(/l) and $(l:aura:fairy_roles)Fairy Charms$(/l) to equip and bind it.
